error.reason: Bu fiil glossu otlama çekirdeğini verir; salma ve yağmurla bitki bolluğu oluşturma kullanımlarını kapsamaz.
Yalnız beslenme durumunu karşılar; hayvanı otlağa salma ve yağmurun otlatacak bitki yeşertmesi anlamlarını dışarıda bırakır.
Gloss verim ve bolluk boyutunu verir; hayvanın otlaması, hayvanı salma ve yağmurla otlak oluşturma boyutlarını içermez.
Yer adı hayvanın beslendiği verimli otlağı verir; hayvanı oraya salma ve yağmurun bitki yeşertmesi kullanımlarını kapsamaz.
Gloss hayvanı verimli otlağa bırakma eylemini verir; yağmurun otlatacak bitki oluşturması anlamını içermez.
Gloss yağmurun otlanacak bitkiyi ortaya çıkarmasını verir; rahat yiyip içme ve hayvanı otlağa salma boyutlarını doğrudan karşılamaz.
Sıfat glossu bitki bolluğunu belirtir; hayvanın fiili otlamasını, rahat yiyip içmesini ve hayvanı salmayı dışarıda bırakır.
Fail glossu beslenen hayvanı verir; sahibin hayvanı salması ve yağmurun otlak bitkisi oluşturması kullanımlarını kapsamaz.
Kişi glossu sürüyü verimli otlağa götürmeyi verir; yağmurun otlanacak bitkiyi yeşertmesi anlamını içermez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi günün erken vaktindeki yeme içme etkinliğini kapsayabilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın satıştan ve aktarılan yan kullanımdan önce gelen temel doğmamış yavru anlamına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın gebe oluşunu ve yavrunun henüz karında bulunmasını korur.

concept_map.definition: Gebe hayvanların karnındaki henüz doğmamış yavruları, kimi kullanımda özellikle koyunların beklenen yavrularını anlatır. Ayrıca o yılki çiftleşmeden beklenen yavru üzerinden yapılan belirsiz satış için ve ayrı bir aktarımda anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlak için kullanılır.

facets.statement: Gebe hayvanların karnında bulunan henüz doğmamış yavrudur.
Kapsam kimi kullanımda koyunlarla sınırlandırılır, başka anlatımda deve ve koyun yavrularını birlikte içerir.
O yılki çiftleşmeden doğması beklenen yavru üzerine yapılan sonucu belirsiz satışın adıdır.
Ayrı bir aktarım, anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu veya oğlağı bu adla belirtir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Henüz doğmamış ve sonucu kesinleşmemiş yavrunun satış konusu yapıldığı işlem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Doğmamış yavrunun işlemden bağımsız temel adını ve aktarılan diğer yan kullanımı kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Beklenen yavru ile bu yavruya dayalı belirsiz satış ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.text: beklenen yavru üzerine yapılan belirsiz satış

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynak sözünde ayrı bir aktarım olarak verilen doğmuş yavru kullanımını açıklamak için uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Gebe hayvanın karnındaki yavru çekirdeğini ve satış kullanımını kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Anne sütüyle beslenmeme koşulunu ve kuzu ya da oğlak kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.text: anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlak

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek doğmamış hayvan yavrusudur; satış kullanımı ve anne sütüyle beslenmeyen yavru anlatımı ayrı yan katmanlardır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Verilen çerçevenin çekirdeği, gebe hayvanların karnındaki henüz doğmamış yavrularla kaynak sözüne uyar. Ancak aynı kaynak sözü kapsamı kimi yerde özellikle koyunlara daraltır, beklenen yavru üzerinden yapılan belirsiz satışı ekler ve anne sütüyle beslenmeyen kuzu ya da oğlağa ilişkin ayrı bir kullanım da aktarır; bu öğeler çekirdek tanıma bağımlı katmanlar olarak korunmalıdır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: gebe hayvanın karnındaki yavru; ayrıca beklenen yavruya dayalı belirsiz satış

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kaynakta tek yalın biçime bağlanan doğmamış yavru çekirdeğini, hayvan türü daralmasını, belirsiz satış kullanımını ve aktarılan yan anlamı birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; doğmamış yavru, daha geniş gebelik ürünü, geleceğe bağlı satış ve doğurma olayıyla kurulan dört sınır dalın kapsamını yeterince açıklar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hayvan yavrusuna, kimi kullanımda özellikle koyuna bağlıdır ve bir satış kullanımına uzanır. Komşu dal ise ana karnındaki yavruyu daha genel biçimde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hayvan yavrusunu, özellikle koyun ve deve kapsamını, ayrıca buna dayalı satış kullanımını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ana karnındaki çocuğu tür ve işlem ayrımı olmadan genel biçimde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal doğumdan önce ana karnında bulunan yavruyu anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hayvanın doğmamış yavrusunu adlandırır ve satışa uzanır; komşu dal gebelik, karındaki yük ve ağacın ürünü gibi daha geniş bir taşıma alanına sahiptir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Beklenen hayvan yavrusuna dayalı belirsiz satış ve özel hayvan kapsamı bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kadın veya dişi hayvanın gebeliğine ve ağacın taşıdığı ürüne kadar genişleyebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal dişi canlının karnında taşınan yavru alanında kesişir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak daldaki işlem belirli bir çiftleşmeden beklenen doğmamış yavruya dayanır; komşu daldaki işlem ise gelecek yılların ürünü veya meyvesi üzerine kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Satış konusu henüz doğmamış ve ortaya çıkıp çıkmayacağı belirsiz hayvan yavrusudur.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: beklenen yavru satışı ile yıllık satış
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İşlem birkaç yılın ürünü ya da meyvesi üzerine kurulan yıllık anlaşmadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sonucu geleceğe bağlı olduğu için sakıncalı görülen satış türleriyle ilişkilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal doğumdan önce karında bulunan yavrunun kendisidir; komşu dal ise bu yavrunun dışarı çıkarılmasıyla sonuçlanan doğurma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yavrunun henüz gebe hayvanın karnında bulunduğu durumu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dişinin karnındaki yavruyu doğurması veya dışarı atması olayını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal gebe hayvan, karnındaki yavru ve doğum sürecinin aynı katılımcılarını paylaşır.

concept_gloss.text: oyun; ciddi bir amaç gütmeyen eğlenceli davranış

concept_map.definition: Oyun, eğlenme ya da şakalaşma amacıyla yapılan ve ciddi, geçerli bir sonuca yönelmeyen davranıştır. Türevler bunun yinelenmesini, bunu sık yapan kişiyi, oyunun türünü, aracını, yerini, mesleğini ve başkasıyla birlikte yapılmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ciddi bir amaca yönelmeyen eğlenceli veya şakacı davranışta bulunma çekirdeği vardır.
Eylemin tekrar tekrar yapılması ve kişinin oyuna çok düşkün olması bu çekirdeğin süreklilik ve kişi uzantılarıdır.
Oyun türü, tek bir oynama, oyun aracı, oyun yeri, oyun giysisi ve oyunculuğu meslek edinmiş kişi adları türetilir.
Belirli kalıplar çok oynayan genç kızı veya başka biriyle karşılıklı oynamayı anlatır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemin yinelenmesini veya kişinin sürekli oyunla uğraşmasını anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Oyun davranışını ve tekrar niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Oyundan türetilen kişi, nesne, tür, tek eylem, giysi, yer ve meslek adlarının açıklanmasında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Türevlerin oyun çekirdeğine bağlı adlandırmalar olduğunu korur.

contextual_glosses.text: oyunla ilgili kişi, araç veya yer

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki kişinin oyuna karşılıklı olarak katıldığı eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Oyun eylemini ve karşılıklı katılımı birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek oyun eylemidir; salya, hayvansal ürün, sıcaklık görüntüsü ve öteki eşsesli dallar bu kapsama girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Dal ifadesi, oyunu ciddi ve geçerli bir amaca yönelmeyen eğlenceli ya da şakacı davranış olarak kurar; yineleme, oyuna düşkün kişi, oyun aracı, oyun türü, oyun yeri, meslek ve karşılıklı katılım değerlerini de bu çekirdeğe bağlı türevler olarak verir. Bu çerçeve dalın kapsamını doğru biçimde temsil eder.

oyun türü ya da kişinin iyi yaptığı oyun tarzı

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın eylem ciddi bir amaç gütmeyen oynama ya da şakalaşmadır; biçim ve kalıp türevleri tekrar, kişi, araç, yer, meslek ve karşılıklı katılım değerlerini ayrıca taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yararlı iki karşılaştırma, genel eğlence alanıyla olan kısmi örtüşmeyi ve belirli bir oyun aracının geniş oyun dalından ayrılışını gösterir. Öteki adaylar tekil oyun adları, uzak bağlam ortaklıkları veya anlamsal örtüşmesi olmayan eşsesli dallardır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı oyun eylemini ve doğrudan türevlerini düzenler; komşu dal zevk ve coşku alanına yayılır, ayrıca odak dalında bulunmayan örtmeceli kullanımlar taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ciddi bir amaç gütmeyen oynama çekirdeği ile oyun nesnesi, yeri ve oyuncu gibi türevler bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Zevk, coşku ve bazı bağlamlarda kişi ya da cinsel ilişki için kullanılan örtmeceli anlamlar bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da oyun ve eğlence alanında ciddi uğraşın karşısında yer alabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı eylem ve geniş türev ailesidir; komşu dal ise yalnızca belirli yapıya sahip tek bir oyun aracını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genel oyun eylemini, oyun türlerini, yerini, oyuncusunu ve çeşitli türevlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çocukların oynadığı, ucuna yumuşak bir madde takılan belirli bir ok, kamış veya tahta aracını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal çocukların oyun etkinliğiyle bağlantılıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın sıvı çekirdeğini doğal biçimde karşılar; akışın başlaması ve salyalı ağız gibi türev durumlar bağlamda ayrıca kurulur.

error_profile.preserves: Tükürüğün ağızdan dışarı akması niteliğini bütünüyle korur.

concept_map.definition: Ağızdan, özellikle çocuğun ağzından kendiliğinden akıp dışarı çıkan tükürük bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Türev kalıplar bu akışın gerçekleşmesini, başlamasını ya da ağızda salya bulunmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ağızdan dışarı akan tükürük, yani salya, dalın temel gönderimidir.
Çocuğun salyasının akması, çekirdek sıvının görüldüğü temel eylem durumudur.
Çocuğun salyasının akmaya başlaması, durumun ortaya çıkışını bildiren bir uzantıdır.
Ağzın salyalı diye nitelenmesi, sıvının bulunduğu yeri öne çıkaran kullanımdır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çocuğun ağzından salya akmasını doğrudan bildiren eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuk katılımcısını ve salyanın akışını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Salyanın akmaya başladığı ve yeni bir durumun ortaya çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Salya akışının başlangıç aşamasını açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağzın salya taşıyan bir durumda olduğunu niteleyen bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Salyanın ağızda bulunması durumunu doğrudan korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ağızdan akan gerçek vücut sıvısıyla sınırlıdır; oyun eylemi, arı balı, yılan zehri ve sıcaklık görüntüsü değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Dal ifadesi ağızdan, özellikle çocuğun ağzından akan salyayı merkeze alır ve çocuğun salyasının akması, akmaya başlaması ile ağzın salyalı olması biçimlerini aynı akış durumuna bağlar. Bu kapsam kanıtlanan anlamı eksiksiz ve tutarlı biçimde temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad ağızdan akan salyayı bildirir; kalıplaşmış eylem ve nitelemeler çocuktaki akışı, akışın başlamasını veya ağızda salya bulunmasını ayrıca anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tükürük, ağız içi ıslaklık ve az tükürükle püskürtme dalları gerçek karışma olasılığı taşıdığı için seçildi. Diğer adaylar farklı vücut çıkışları, anatomik yerler veya yalnızca aynı senaryoya uzaktan bağlanan anlamlardır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında belirleyici özellik sıvının ağızdan akmasıdır; komşu dalda ise tükürük, dışarı atılmış ürün ve tükürme eylemi daha geniş bir alan oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ağızdan kendiliğinden akan salyayı ve özellikle çocuktaki akış durumunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tükürme sonucu çıkan maddeyi ve bu maddeyi çıkarma eylemini adlandıran biçimleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ağız sıvısı olan tükürükle ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı dışarı akan belirli sıvıyı adlandırır; komşu dal yalnızca ağız içindeki ıslaklık durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ağızdan dışarı doğru gerçekleşen belirgin salya akışını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ağız içindeki genel ıslaklık veya nem durumunu, dışarı akış şartı olmadan bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ağızda bulunan sıvı ve ıslaklık durumuyla ilgilidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı akan sıvıya dayanır; komşu dal ise sıvının eşlik ettiği kısa bir çıkarma veya üfleme eylemine dayanır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sürekli veya kendiliğinden akan salyanın kendisini ve bu akış durumunu bildirir.

activation_trace.role: The release-and-dispatch sense makes the request a transfer out of present custody.
The following-day sense bounds the proposed freedom in a deferred outing.
The human enjoyment-in-plenty sense supplies the overt benefit promised to Joseph.
The non-serious activity sense supplies recreation alongside expansive enjoyment.

changed_reading.after: Joseph should be released from present custody for a bounded interval of abundant recreation.
changed_reading.before: Joseph should accompany the brothers tomorrow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 imperative, word-3 deferment, and coordinated word-4 and word-5 activities.
baseline_models.mechanism: A delayed handoff releases Joseph from present custody into a bounded occasion of expansive human enjoyment and non-serious play.

activation_trace.role: The familiarity-and-ease sense frames the requested company as a place of claimed safety.
Active care and custody supply the practical obligation assumed by the brothers.
Honor, covenant, and keeping faith turn the assurance into a pledged duty rather than mere proximity.

changed_reading.after: The request proposes a fiduciary handoff secured by both practical custody and an honor-bound pledge.
changed_reading.before: The brothers say they will watch Joseph.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-1 request to release him into the brothers' company and the emphatic guardian claim at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: Release is conditioned by a collective assumption of fiduciary care: Joseph may be free because attention, custody, and honor-duty are transferred to his companions.

activation_trace.role: Unrestricted human enjoyment supplies Joseph's absorbed role within the proposed outing.
Play supplies the lowered seriousness that makes a separate vigilant role necessary.
Wakeful caution supplies the brothers' claimed counter-role to Joseph's recreational absorption.

changed_reading.after: His absorption in leisure is licensed by their claimed counter-role of uninterrupted vigilance.
changed_reading.before: Joseph can play while the brothers happen to be nearby.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The leisure pair at words 4-5 set against the vigilance claim at word 8.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse partitions roles: Joseph's attention can expand into leisure only because the brothers claim concentrated vigilance; freedom and protection are mutually conditioning promises.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate contrivance supplies an adversarial purpose already attached to fraternal access.
Settled security and trust supply the exact disposition the appeal seeks from the father.
Purity from adulteration supplies the brothers' claim that their motive contains no concealed mixture.
Covenant-keeping and honor supply the strongest warranty in the access request.
Inward beautification supplies the mechanism by which a harmful plan is made presentable.
Direct opposition to truth exposes the eventual evidentiary product of the assurances.

changed_reading.after: The apparent covenant of care doubles as an access mechanism: protection vocabulary is the instrument by which protection is removed.
changed_reading.before: The father is offered a sincere delegated-care arrangement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assurance sequence stacks requested trust, claimed purity, and pledged keeping over a pre-existing plot; later inward embellishment and false evidence expose the stack as a designed access credential.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrivance, trust language, purity language, the keeping pledge, and later falsehood; I infer that the assurances are causally arranged to overcome the father's resistance. A live alternative is that some assurance language remains conventional persuasion even inside a plot.
structural_cues: The warning about plotting in 12:5 precedes the trust appeal and keeping pledge in 12:11-12.
The fabricated evidence and diagnosis of inward embellishment in 12:18 follow the successful handoff.

activation_trace.role: Wide grazing and eating in plenty supply the focus's pastoral side of the food-chain image.
A surrounding, mutually supporting group supplies both the claimed security and the coalition able to control the account.
The prepared-prey sense reverses the focus's eater enjoying abundance into one exposed to being eaten.
Wolfish guile and predation supply the counter-image that shadows the promised pasture.

changed_reading.after: The promised pasture is also exposure within a food chain: the one invited to enjoy becomes the object around which predation is narrated.
changed_reading.before: Joseph will range freely and enjoy plenty under group protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: A self-supporting collective requests access to a pasture-coded child, after which the context switches from grazing abundance to prepared prey and wolfish predation. Collective strength ceases to guarantee safety and instead enables exposure while lending one voice to the predator account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grazing abundance, a surrounding group, prepared prey, and wolf predation; I infer a semantic reversal in which the requested outing exposes Joseph as consumable and the coalition occupies the functional predator position. The live alternative is that the wolf remains only a hypothetical risk and later alibi, not an identity for the brothers.
structural_cues: The food-and-pasture verb in 12:12 is answered immediately by eating and wolf language in 12:13-14.
In 12:14 the brothers place their group strength beside the same predation scenario.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch toward pasture and movement in successive groups supply the first stage of a relay.
Ground below the open sky supplies the planned displacement away from household custody.
Casting until an object lies thrown supplies the violent transition from accompanied person to placed object.
A depression in which something disappears supplies the concealment stage of the route.
The cut, unlined well supplies the specific container that interrupts ordinary travel.
Picking up a fallen or cast-off object supplies the projected extraction from the container.
A moving group supplies the replacement collective expected to carry Joseph onward.

changed_reading.after: Release opens a concealed transfer route that converts companionship into casting, containment, and anticipated pickup by another group.
changed_reading.before: Release sends Joseph outward with his brothers for an open-air outing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus request becomes the first stage of a transport chain: dispatch toward apparent open range, groundward casting, concealment in a receiving cavity, and projected pickup by another moving collective.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dispatch, pasture-linked movement, casting, a hidden depression, a well, pickup, and a moving group; I infer one spatial relay in which the outing is cover for transfer between custodial zones. The live alternative is that pickup remains only the planner's projected rescue within this window, while the well placement alone is explicitly executed.
structural_cues: The displacement plan in 12:9-10 precedes the request whose approval makes it executable.
The actual placement in the hidden part of the well in 12:15 repeats the planned middle stages.

activation_trace.role: Wakeful caution supplies the positive standard asserted by the brothers.
Lapse that leaves something outside awareness supplies the father's precise negation of their standard.
Letting go of and leaving something supplies the brothers' own reported breach of custody.

changed_reading.after: Their promise names, by exact opposition, the vigilance they will suspend and later admit suspending.
changed_reading.before: The brothers promise active vigilance during Joseph's leisure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father names the exact failure mode opposite to vigilant keeping, and the later report places deliberate leaving inside the recreational interval. The pledge consequently becomes an anti-definition of what follows.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies vigilant keeping, heedless lapse, and abandonment; I infer that 12:13 functions as an advance anti-definition of the 12:12 pledge and that 12:17 realizes it. A live alternative is an accidental lapse, but the prior plot keeps deliberate breach active.
structural_cues: The pronominal target of the keeping claim in 12:12 becomes the target of feared inattention in 12:13.
The report in 12:17 embeds Joseph's abandonment inside the account of the group's recreation.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message sense lets physical dispatch carry a secondary communicative trajectory.
Knowledge cast secretly into its recipient supplies the concealed message acquired within the pit scene.
News that arrives and is communicated supplies the future return path of what is learned.

changed_reading.after: His physical dispatch also begins an exploratory delayed-message arc in which concealment generates the disclosure that will return.
changed_reading.before: The brothers ask that Joseph be physically sent with them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The person requested for physical dispatch also becomes the bearer and content of delayed disclosure: the journey into concealment receives hidden knowledge and bends toward a future report to the perpetrators.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical sending, secretly imparted knowledge, and future communicated news; I infer that Joseph's dispatch initiates a delayed message that will return to those dispatching him. The live alternative is that the communication echo is literary only and the focus verb remains purely physical.
structural_cues: The focus opens with dispatch, while 12:15 closes the concealment scene with a future second-person disclosure.
Physical removal and future communication point in opposite directions, allowing the message to return after the person is hidden.

activation_trace.role: The following day supplies the opening edge of the promised excursion.
Evening darkness and reduced clarity supply the closing conditions under which the account is presented.
Affected or manufactured weeping supplies the performed emotional layer of the return.
Falsehood supplies the status of the evidence presented after the timed absence.

changed_reading.after: Tomorrow opens a controlled interval whose evening closure supports a staged account of what occurred inside it.
changed_reading.before: Tomorrow merely dates a short recreational outing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next-day proposal opens a bounded temporal window; return at low-clarity evening with performed grief and false evidence closes it. The date marker becomes operational timing for action and presentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies next-day timing, evening obscurity, affected weeping, and false evidence; I infer that the outing's temporal boundary also becomes a staging window. A live alternative is that evening is simply the normal return time and contributes atmosphere rather than deliberate concealment.
structural_cues: The following-day marker in 12:12 and evening return in 12:16 form the temporal edges of the absence.
Performed grief appears at the closing edge, followed by the false evidentiary display in 12:18.

activation_trace.role: Non-serious activity supplies the broad recreational premise announced before the outing.
Racing and striving to get ahead supply the later concrete version of the announced play.
Abandoning what one had charge of supplies the lapse made possible by the reported race.
Useful equipment and belongings supply the stationary location at which the report says Joseph was left.

changed_reading.after: Play also plants the category later used to explain why the pledged guardians were occupied elsewhere.
changed_reading.before: Play is simply one benefit Joseph will enjoy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generic play is later specified as racing while Joseph is left by useful belongings. The overt purpose in the request therefore supplies the ready-made division of attention used in the report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies announced play, later racing, abandonment, and belongings; I infer that the focus's leisure wording prefigures a usable alibi for divided attention. A live alternative is that the exact racing account was improvised after the plan rather than encoded in the original appeal.
structural_cues: The purpose clause in 12:12 precedes the later explanation of the brothers' competing activity in 12:17.
The 12:17 report decomposes the focus's leisure-and-guarding pair into racing and leaving Joseph elsewhere.

remaining_uncertainties: The pasture verb can retain ordinary human enjoyment even while the predator-prey reversal remains active.
The evening return may be an ordinary schedule rather than deliberately selected low-visibility staging.
The delayed-message, commercial, mirage, and venom readings are analogical branch activations, not substitute lexical translations.
strongest_changes: The care pledge changes from fiduciary protection into the access credential that removes protection.
Pastoral enjoyment reverses into prey exposure when eating and wolf imagery answer the focus.
Play becomes the category later used to explain divided attention, while vigilant keeping is negated by heedlessness and abandonment.
Release becomes a spatial relay from apparent open range into casting, hidden containment, and projected pickup by another group.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only reading genuinely supports recreation, companionship, and delegated care, but context activates several coexisting adversarial readings without erasing that baseline. The most unusual survivals are a delayed-message arc and contained material analogies of unseen-risk exchange, mirage-like evidence, and venomous bait.

activation_trace.role: Unseen contents and their uncertain exchange turn the promised future interval into an object whose safety cannot yet be inspected.
Credence that settles the heart supplies the assent requested for performance that remains unseen.
Exchange based on description rather than sight supplies the analogy's closure when an account is offered where Joseph should be.

changed_reading.after: Tomorrow also resembles an unseen-risk transfer accepted on verbal warranty and later answered by description rather than return of the entrusted person.
changed_reading.before: Tomorrow is only the date of the proposed outing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a commercial-risk branch inside an ordinary date word. It remains anchored in word 3 and is reinforced by requested credence and a later description offered in place of direct sight; downstream prose should render it as a transaction-like material analogy, not as a legal classification of the handoff.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 3's next-day expression, especially its remote branch concerning uncertain unseen contents.

activation_trace.role: Heat-thread and mirage-like appearance supply an unstable visual layer beneath the attractive recreation scene.
The worn garment supplies the material display surface used to support the account.
Blood-red staining supplies the visible mark applied to that surface.
A garment whose outward condition lies supplies the precise contextual answer to the mirage-like promise.

changed_reading.after: The promised recreation can also be carried as a mirage-like visual fiction, later answered by a manufactured garment display.
changed_reading.before: The play scene is a transparent promise of harmless recreation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the mirage-like branch is distant from ordinary play. It remains focus-anchored and meets an unusually exact contextual image in which a garment's condition misreports reality; downstream prose should preserve it as a visual-fiction analogy rather than substitute mirage for the lexical sense of play.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5's play root through its branch of heat-born threads and unstable appearance.

activation_trace.role: Animal fluid that can become honey or venom supplies an ambivalent material underside to attractive play.
Calculated guile supplies the hidden harmful intention inside the attractive offer.
Predatory animal guile supplies the context that activates the branch's toxic animal edge.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the play offer has a toxic underside: an attractive surface carrying concealed predatory harm.
changed_reading.before: Play is harmless bait only in the ordinary rhetorical sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because animal saliva and venom are remote branch material for the ordinary play verb. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by explicit contrivance and predatory imagery; downstream prose should qualify it as an image of toxic bait, never as a translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 5's play root through its animal-fluid branch, including the venomous edge of that branch.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Release is packaged as abundance under guard.** ر س ل B001 (being sent forth/released), ر ت ع B001/B002 (free grazing; human ease in abundance), and ح ف ظ B001 (guarding) place freedom inside a promise of containment. I infer that leisure is offered as the persuasive surface while custody transfers to the speakers. The ayah reads as a proposed change of guardianship.
2. **Play carries an unresolved purposelessness.** ل ع ب B001 (non-serious action without sound aim) can describe innocent recreation, yet the prior plot activates a darker mismatch between stated purpose and intended act. Both readings remain: promised play is genuine bait, and “play” also masks action severed from a sound end.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:63 reused the promise of guarding almost verbatim; the repetition made this first promise a dangerous template rather than an isolated persuasion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Guardianship tested by watchful presence.** `ح ف ظ:B001` is preserving and guarding an entrusted thing; dormant `ح ف ظ:B004` is “watchful caution.” The claim is framed by the father’s fear that they will be inattentive (12:13) and their counterclaim that group strength makes loss impossible (12:14), but 12:17 says they left Joseph elsewhere. The packet supplies claim, standard, and breach; I infer that guarding requires continuous attention, not group status. *Laḥāfiẓūn* reads as an auditable role whose later narration disproves it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:81 has the brothers restrict their testimony to what they know and deny guardianship of the unseen, a direct correction to the unqualified confidence with which protection is promised here.

words.gloss_range: send him by authorized release; the local imperative makes Jacob the agent of custody transfer, while wider sending and release registers remain controlled by this domestic request
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسِلْهُ}} ({{tr:arsilhu}}) opens the ayah as a demand on Jacob's authority: the brothers are not describing Yusuf's own movement, but asking the father to cause the transfer. The attached object keeps Yusuf compactly inside the verb, and the following purpose and guarantee clauses depend on that permission. The root also gives the request a release-image, especially beside the later pasture promise, and the word's light liquid-sibilant movement can support that already licensed release effect. Broader messenger and divine-sending associations remain resonance rather than a replacement for the local household command; they also contrast with scenes where sending and guardianship are assigned or denied in other moral frames (6:61; 4:80; 9:65; 83:33). The same send-and-guard custody pattern returns in the Benjamin scene (12:63), so this first command already sounds like a repeated family negotiation over custody.
words.root_gloss_range: sending, dispatching, releasing, and loose outward movement; messenger-language pressure is present as root background, but the local Form IV imperative selects caused sending of Yusuf

topics.headline: imperative makes Jacob cause the custody transfer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers need Jacob to authorize Yusuf's movement, so the request presses paternal custody rather than reporting a simple outing.
topics.reason: The aligned word is a Form IV imperative with a 3ms object suffix, and the attachment evidence treats the suffix as the direct object governed by the command.

topics.headline: object suffix carries Yusuf across the ayah boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf is not renamed; the compact suffix makes 12:12 depend on the prior naming and turns the earlier trust dispute into a concrete custody request.
topics.reason: The bundle resolves the 3ms suffix back to Yusuf from the preceding ayah and marks the request as dependent on that discourse referent.

topics.headline: opening command governs the purpose beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's sequence: command first, proposed activity second, and guarantee third.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence links the later jussives as purpose or result content under the opening imperative.

topics.headline: release imagery sharpens the command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command can feel like loosening Jacob's protective hold, not only dispatching Yusuf from one point to another.
topics.reason: The release and loose-motion pressure is coherent beside the pasture-purpose clause, while local Form IV grammar keeps the selected act as caused sending by Jacob.

topics.headline: domestic command touches the wider sending register
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a household request is worded with a root family that elsewhere carries mission and messenger associations, without making Yusuf's local outing a prophetic mission.
topics.reason: The root field allows sending-register resonance, but QAC and attachment evidence select a domestic imperative addressed to Jacob.

topics.headline: send and guard become a custody formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this request shape is not isolated; the same custody negotiation returns when another brother is requested (12:63).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows name the same-surah recurrence, and the local phrase joins sending with a later guardianship pledge in one pragmatic unit.

topics.headline: human custody contrasts with assigned guardianship elsewhere
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a contrast between the brothers' self-authored custody claim and passages where sending, guarding, or play carry very different moral force (6:61; 4:80; 9:65; 83:33).
topics.reason: The concrete references can stand as contrastive apparatus, but they do not control the local parse of the imperative.

topics.headline: command is answered as risk of removal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command converts distrust into logistics, and Jacob's next response reframes sending as taking Yusuf away (12:13).
topics.reason: The local command is the first operational step after the prior trust dispute, and the next ayah directly answers its requested movement.

topics.headline: light sound texture supports the release effect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word's sound can reinforce the already licensed release image, without serving as independent semantic proof.
topics.reason: The sound note is retained only as a minor support for the release topic already grounded by lexical and local-context evidence.

words.gloss_range: with us; accompaniment that makes the brothers the proposed custody-space and rhetorical warrant for their later guardianship claim
words.prose: {{ar:مَعَنَا}} ({{tr:maʿanā}}) turns sending into sending into the brothers' company. The first-person plural suffix makes the proposed space socially defined by them, and its position before the time and activity words foregrounds custody before schedule or recreation. Its local force is accompaniment, but the custody and supervision pressure survives because the later guarantee depends on Yusuf being with them.

topics.headline: with-us phrase defines the custody space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the request is not bare release; Yusuf is to be placed specifically in the brothers' company.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the phrase an adverbial accompaniment attached to the sending verb, and the suffix identifies the speaking group.

topics.headline: company is circumstance rather than object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers are not a second object of the command; they are the circumstance into which Yusuf would be sent.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence classify the word as accompaniment/adverbial, while the category dispute does not undo the local adverbial role.

topics.headline: withness carries supervision pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why accompaniment can support a guardianship pledge: being with the brothers is presented as the condition for supervision.
topics.reason: The local phrase means with-us accompaniment, and the supervision/custody pressure is narrowed to the rhetorical warrant it gives the later pledge.

topics.headline: company precedes time and activity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers are named as company before the ayah gives the time or the promised activities.
topics.reason: The suffix is fused to the accompaniment word, and the word order places this company phrase directly after the command.

words.gloss_range: tomorrow as a bounded near-future time adverb; locally it schedules the whole proposed outing and makes the trust dispute actionable
words.prose: {{ar:غَدًا}} ({{tr:ghadan}}) gives the request a near, bounded slot. The brothers are not asking for open-ended permission; they turn the dispute over trust into a tomorrow-plan that covers the sending, the activity pair, and the pledge. The root background of morning departure can sharpen the outing rhythm, but the local surface is an accusative time adverb, not a separate departure verb.

topics.headline: time adverb bounds the proposal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers make their request concrete and near rather than leaving permission vague.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as an accusative time adverb, and attachment evidence scopes it with the opening request.

topics.headline: morning-departure pressure supports the outing scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the time word as part of a concrete outward foray, while the grammar keeps it from becoming an explicit departure verb.
topics.reason: The root image can color the schedule, but the local form is a nominal adverbial time expression.

topics.headline: single time marker scopes the whole proposal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one time marker gathers request, purpose, and guarantee into the same planned outing.
topics.reason: The word closes the request beat before the purpose clause, and no other time marker appears in the ayah.

topics.headline: trust argument becomes outdoor logistics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from an inward question of trust to a dated outdoor plan.
topics.reason: The time adverb and the following activity verb relocate the discourse from trust argument to scheduled excursion.

words.gloss_range: let him roam, graze, or enjoy freely in the purpose clause; the local active Form I jussive makes Yusuf the implied subject while pastoral abundance remains the governing image
words.prose: {{ar:يَرْتَعْ}} ({{tr:yartaʿ}}) begins the purpose beat: Yusuf is to have pasture-like freedom because Jacob sends him. The omitted object lets grazing, roaming, and enjoyment remain open rather than naming one food or place. The root is a Quranic hapax here, so the pastoral image has unusual local weight, and the guttural close gives the unusual pasture verb a rougher audible edge. Variant readings test whether the brothers, Yusuf, or a passive subject carries the activity, and one mood variant can loosen the second activity toward more independent description; the aligned local surface still keeps Yusuf as the active implied subject of the jussive.
words.root_gloss_range: grazing, ranging freely, enjoying pasture-like abundance, and related causative or reflexive variants; the local form selects simple active jussive enjoyment rather than causative feeding or passive patienthood

topics.headline: jussive purpose keeps Yusuf as implied subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf's promised freedom is grammatically dependent on Jacob granting the command.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as a 3ms imperfect jussive after the imperative, and attachment evidence recovers Yusuf as the implied subject.

topics.headline: omitted object leaves pasture-like enjoyment open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a broad promise of roaming and enjoyment rather than a tightly specified activity.
topics.reason: The local verb has no object, so the pasture and abundance imagery survives as open lexical pressure rather than a named object.

topics.headline: self-directed freedom is contextual, not stem-marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the outing is advertised as Yusuf's own free enjoyment, while the surface stem does not itself encode reflexive self-grazing.
topics.reason: The Form VIII reflexive evidence can sharpen the family image, but the local surface is Form I.

topics.headline: variant readings expose agency pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the activity can be re-voiced across accepted readings as Yusuf's benefit, group participation, brotherly provision, or passive affectedness.
topics.reason: The variants are useful apparatus for agency, but they do not replace the aligned 3ms active jussive surface.

topics.headline: indicative variant tests purpose dependency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mood variation can loosen how tightly the second activity is heard under the command frame.
topics.reason: The variant clarifies scope possibilities, while the local aligned form remains jussive in the purpose clause.

topics.headline: hapax root makes the pasture image weighty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah spends a unique Quranic root on the promised freedom, so the pasture image is not routine background.
topics.reason: The bundle marks the root as a sole Quranic occurrence, making the local lexical image unusually concentrated.

topics.headline: pasture verb is yoked to play
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that grazing freedom and play form one paired promise, not two unrelated activities.
topics.reason: The first jussive begins the middle beat and is coordinated with the following jussive under the same purpose frame.

topics.headline: guttural close gives the hapax audible weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a rougher audible edge on the unusual pasture verb, without treating sound as independent proof of meaning.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation supports the already grounded hapax and pasture-image topics.

topics.headline: release and pasture complete one outing image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a concrete circuit: Jacob releases, and Yusuf roams in pasture-like abundance.

words.prose: {{ar:حَافِظُونَ}} ({{tr:ḥāfiẓūn}}) closes the ayah by naming the identity the brothers claim: not merely that they will guard once, but that they are guardians. The active participle, plural ending, and nominal predication make protection sound continuous and collective, while the plural participle avoids casting the claim as one intensified singular guardian. The root's preservation range lets the claim feel stronger than momentary watching, while later same-surah and cross-surah contrasts expose its fragility: the formula returns for another brother (12:63), the root keeps recurring around custody and ability (12:55; 12:64; 12:65; 12:81), Jacob answers with God as the better guardian (12:64), and other passages assign, deny, or limit guardianship in ways that make the brothers' self-appointment stand out (6:61; 4:80; 13:11; 42:48; 83:33). The closing claim also turns the prior sincerity pledge into active protection and anticipates Jacob's fear of inattention in the next ayah (12:13).
